blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) App Connector version.
This App Connector version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released to support the version check and automated upgrade of App Connectors versions 24.650.5 and above during an initial connection. To learn more, see Zscaler Trust.
An update was released to improve AppProtection inspection for subdomains when they include a generic domain. To learn more, see Configuring Defined Application Segments.
An update was released to improve cloud support and scalability.
An update was released to support Active Directory controls for AppProtection. To learn more, see Active Directory Controls.

blocks.text: Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see Understanding App Connector Software Updates.
An update was released that includes updated App Connector RPM packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.x, 8.x, and 9.x. The Manager software version is 24.650.5.
To learn more, see Understanding the Manager Software.
This App Connector version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: Support for Business Continuity. To learn more, see Business Continuity Support.
Support for VPN (for Legacy Apps). To learn more, see VPN (for Legacy Apps).

blocks.text: Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see Understanding App Connector Software Updates.
